images.title: Your investigation in four steps
images.purpose: Shows the plan of a data investigation: ask a question, collect data, summarise with mean and median, show it.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. Four equal rounded boxes in one row across the centre joined by three arrows, each box with one simple icon.
images.exact_structure: Four equal rounded rectangles in a row with thin dark outlines, joined left to right by three grey (#6B7280) arrows. Box 1 has a large teal (#0072B2) question mark and the label Ask a question. Box 2 has four teal tally strokes crossed by a fifth and the label Collect data. Box 3 has a small amber (#E69F00) balance triangle under a short line and the label Mean and median. Box 4 has a short strip of 6 boxes, 3 filled reddish purple (#CC79A7), and the label Show it. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A data story goes: ask, collect, summarise, show.
images.description: Shows the plan of a data investigation: ask a question, collect data, summarise with mean and median, show it.
images.context: Matches the doer recap: collect, summarise with mean and median, show, then say what you found.

image_decisions.why: A four step plan diagram gives the project's whole route at a glance.
